title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 把 AI 的下一阶段讲得很具体：agent 不只是更聪明的聊天框，而是正在变成可嵌入任何表面的工作内核、消耗更多 token 的执行系统，以及让同一家公司内部出现 10 倍生产力差距的新基础设施。与此同时，Amjad Masad 提醒我们，最强模型不等于赢得全球 AI 竞争，真正的竞争还在于谁能让更多国家把模型、芯片和基础设施装进自己的 stack。最后，Jensen 的回归把这条产业链的地缘政治一面直接推到了台前。

archive.title: Agent 底座日报
archive.desc: Agent 正从工具升级为工作内核，token、部署栈和组织采用速度共同决定下一轮 AI 竞争。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-25 source feeds.

sections.title: The Agent Becomes the Runtime / Agent 变成运行时
sections.desc: 今天最值得注意的不是某个新模型，而是 agent 正被做成可以到处运行的基础内核。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch says the CLI is mainly a thin wrapper around libfix. The real goal is a minimal, intelligent coding-agent kernel that can be embedded in browsers, servers, mobile, desktop, operating systems, and ADEs. The surface is the product; the kernel is the strategic layer.
original: The goal is to produce the smallest and most intelligent coding agent kernel, that's embeddable on any surface: browsers, servers, mobile, desktop, OS, ADEs…

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 说，CLI 本质上只是 libfix 的一个薄封装。真正的目标是做一个尽可能小、尽可能聪明的 coding-agent kernel，然后把它嵌进浏览器、服务器、手机、桌面、操作系统和 ADE。表面是产品，内核才是战略层。
original: 目标是做出最小、最智能的 coding agent kernel，可以嵌入浏览器、服务器、移动端、桌面、OS 和 ADE。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad argues that token demand does not grow smoothly like electricity consumption. Each harness step—from autocomplete to chat, agents, long-running autonomous agents, and swarms—can unlock an order of magnitude more usage per person. The catch is a lag: users still need time to discover what to do with the new tools.
original: auto-complete -> chat -> agent -> long-running autonomous agents -> swarms
Each harness innovation unlocks an order of magnitude more potential token consumption.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 认为，token 需求不会像用电量那样平滑增长。从 autocomplete 到 chat、agent、长期自主 agent，再到 swarm，每一次 harness 创新都可能把单个用户的潜在消耗拉高一个数量级。问题是，工具出现后，用户还需要时间摸索它们到底能拿来做什么。
original: autocomplete → chat → agent → long-running autonomous agents → swarms
每次 harness 创新都会释放一个数量级的潜在 token 消耗。

sections.title: The Adoption Gap Inside Companies / 公司内部的采用鸿沟
sections.desc: AI 的影响不再只是公司之间的差距，而开始变成同一家公司不同团队之间的巨大分层。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie says AI is producing a new kind of organizational inequality: teams inside the same company can now see a 10X productivity gap depending on how well they redesign workflows around agents. That is different from cloud or digital adoption, which usually standardized the uplift across a firm. For now the effect is concentrated in coding, but coding-adjacent work is next.
original: Even within the same company you can have a 10X delta between the lowest and highest adopters of AI and the impact they're seeing.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 说，AI 正在制造一种新的组织不平等：同一家公司里，不同团队因为是否真正围绕 agent 重做工作流，生产力可能相差 10 倍。这和 cloud 或数字化不一样，后者通常会让整家公司获得相对统一的提升。目前这种差距主要集中在 coding，接下来会扩散到所有 coding adjacent 的工作。
original: 即使在同一家公司里，AI 采用程度最低和最高的团队，其生产力影响也可能相差 10 倍。

rewrite: YC President and CEO Garry Tan points to the less technical bottleneck: society has a limit on how quickly people can absorb changes to knowledge work. Even when models can do more, people resist moving the cheese. The adoption curve is therefore constrained not only by model capability, but by how much organizational change people will tolerate.
original: Society hit a limit in its ability to absorb the tech socially. There are natural brakes on how much a knowledge work process or business process can change: people don't like their cheese moved.

rewrite: YC President and CEO Garry Tan 指出，真正的瓶颈未必在技术，而在社会能多快消化知识工作的变化。模型能力继续上升，但人们并不喜欢被挪动奶酪。换句话说，采用曲线不仅受模型能力限制，也受组织愿意承受多少变化限制。
original: 社会对技术的吸收能力撞上了上限。知识工作或业务流程能改变多少，存在天然刹车：人们不喜欢自己的奶酪被挪走。

sections.title: Who Owns the Stack? / 谁掌握完整技术栈
sections.desc: 从模型到 electrons，今天的讨论把 AI 竞争重新拉回到部署、基础设施和全球采用。

rewrite: Amjad Masad's geopolitical point is blunt: America can build the best frontier models and still lose the global AI race. Countries want sovereign AI that runs on their own soil and infrastructure; if American companies do not meet that demand, Chinese models, chips, and infrastructure will become the default stack. Frontier quality matters, but global deployment creates lasting strategic influence.
original: America can build the best frontier models and still lose the global AI race.
Having the smartest model won't mean much if most of the world runs on someone else's stack.

rewrite: Amjad Masad 的地缘政治判断很直接：美国即使做出最强的 frontier model，也可能输掉全球 AI 竞争。各国想要的是能在本土、自己的基础设施上运行的 sovereign AI；如果美国公司满足不了这个需求，中国的模型、芯片和基础设施就会成为默认 stack。模型最强很重要，但全球部署才会形成长期战略影响力。
original: 美国可以做出最强的 frontier model，却仍然输掉全球 AI 竞争。
如果世界大部分地区运行在别人的 stack 上，拥有最聪明的模型也没多大意义。

rewrite: Investor Nikunj Kothari turns the 2026 startup map into a one-line ownership game: app companies own the workflow, harness companies put intelligence to work, inference companies serve it, model companies build it, data companies feed it, infra companies keep it running, chip companies control the sand, and energy companies control the electrons. The joke is also a useful map of where value can accrue.
original: App companies: He who owns the workflow controls the universe.
Energy companies: He who controls the electrons controls the universe.

rewrite: 投资人 Nikunj Kothari 用一句话画出了 2026 创业地图：app 公司掌握 workflow，harness 公司让 intelligence 真正工作，inference 公司负责服务 intelligence，model 公司构建 intelligence，data 公司喂养 intelligence，infra 公司让它持续运行，chip 公司掌握 sand，energy 公司掌握 electrons。虽然像玩笑，但也是一张很有用的价值归属图。
original: App 公司：掌握 workflow 的人掌握宇宙。
Energy 公司：掌握 electrons 的人掌握宇宙。

sections.title: The Jensen Question / Jensen 事件的产业回声
sections.desc: 这期播客把一次高管回归，拆成芯片合规、中国市场与 AI 地缘政治的交叉问题。

rewrite: The takeaway: Jensen Huang's return is not a reset button. The episode frames the Nvidia story as a collision between chip demand, export controls, smuggling allegations, and the question of whether American AI can keep the rest of the world on its stack. Jordan Schneider argues that China wants both local access to chips and remote access through overseas data centers, while the politics around those channels remain unsettled. The broader lesson is uncomfortable: technical leadership is inseparable from compliance and geopolitics once the infrastructure becomes strategic.
original: This does not feel like a steady state for me.
We need to take a step back: is Jensen going to be a whole lot more circumspect when it comes to building his book of Chinese business going forward?

rewrite: 这期节目的核心判断是：Jensen Huang 的回归不是按下重置键。Nvidia 的故事其实是芯片需求、出口管制、走私指控，以及美国 AI 能否让全球继续使用其技术栈之间的碰撞。Jordan Schneider 认为，中国既想在本土获得芯片，也想通过海外 data center 远程访问；而这些渠道的政策命运仍未稳定。更大的教训是，一旦基础设施变成战略资产，技术领先就不可能和合规、地缘政治分开。
original: 这对我来说不像是一个稳定状态。
Jensen 接下来在拓展中国业务时，会不会更加谨慎？

sections.title: Builders Shipping / Builder 的现场信号
sections.desc: 少量但值得留下的产品更新：从 MCP skill 到 OpenClaw 的可靠性，都是 agent 走向日常使用的细节。

rewrite: Claude Code creator Boris Cherny announces that MCP servers can now ship with their own skills, so Claude Code can know how to use them out of the box. It is a small packaging change with a large workflow implication: capability and the instructions for using that capability can travel together.
original: MCP servers can now ship with their own skills, so Claude Code knows how to use them out of the box.

rewrite: Claude Code 创作者 Boris Cherny 宣布，MCP server 现在可以自带 skills，Claude Code 开箱就知道怎么使用它们。这是一个小的打包变化，却会明显改变工作流：能力本身和使用能力的说明，可以一起分发。
original: MCP server 现在可以自带 skills，让 Claude Code 开箱就知道怎么用。

rewrite: OpenClaw founder Peter Steinberger says the project has found a niche in prosumer and enterprise adoption, with multiplayer teams as a standout feature. The less glamorous work now dominates: speed, reliability, security, a new memory system, and the coming OpenClaw ID. Shipping free open source means waking up to user complaints every day, so reliability is not polish—it is the product.
original: We mostly been focussing on the boring part of ensuring things are fast, reliable and secure, with the exception of the new memory system and soon OpenClaw ID.

rewrite: OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 说，项目已经在 prosumer 和 enterprise adoption 中找到了自己的位置，multiplayer team 功能尤其突出。现在最占精力的反而是那些不性感的事：速度、可靠性、安全性、新的 memory system，以及即将到来的 OpenClaw ID。免费开源意味着每天醒来都会面对用户投诉，所以可靠性不是 polish，而就是产品本身。
original: 我们主要在做那些无聊但重要的事：确保系统快速、可靠、安全；例外是新的 memory system 和即将到来的 OpenClaw ID。
